additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Brogioli,
Thanks for your support and patience, according to our records your issue/query has been resolved for case # 0428206, the case is now closed.
No, chargers do not require regular restarts. If you encounter such an issue, please create a new ticket
Problem Description
:
connectors are completely out of service.
Resolution
:  Chargers are available and Healthy.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
